Callout 2 points at a select labelled "Label" with its native menu open showing "Select" (checked), "Option 1", "Option 2", "Option 3" and "Option 4", used for 5 to 20 items. Callout 3 points at a combobox labelled "Country" where "B" has been typed with a clear icon and a dropdown list with "Label", "Label", "Bangladesh", "Label" and "Label" appears, used for more than 20 items.
